mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body was most worthwhile: the result showed where the diaphragm sits and explained that nerves, blood vessels and the food pipe cross between regions by separate routes.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the urinary organs was clear but mostly a named-slot placement, so it gave me less to figure out.

surprise.text: The joined body made the different jobs of nerves and blood clearer: the same muscle needs signals and a supply of materials.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though several placements followed explicit slots or goals rather than requiring much reasoning.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems work together. The final connections were interesting, though the straightforward placements alone would not be much of a draw.
